purpose: Public figures through verifiable work, collaborators, institutions, media systems, changing reputation, and public memory.
editorial_principles: Use a named jurisdiction, population, and date where applicable.
Present comparisons on equal terms and label illustrative scenarios.
Verify primary sources and current guidance before production.
Name person, place, period, and claim. Separate public-interest facts from private life, avoid inferred motives or diagnoses, corroborate anecdotes, and document corrections.
